## YT-Chatterino 2.5.9

- Suggest more channel name variants such as `livesdo_name`, `live_name`, and `name_live`. Suggestions still require your selection.
- Improve 7TV emote loading with a fallback endpoint, longer timeouts, and support for larger sets. Control explicit 7TV emotes under Settings → Messages; they are shown by default when available in the channel set.
- Limit concurrent channel lookups to reduce network load.

The browser extension is unchanged; Firefox continues using the signed 2.5.8 extension.
